expectations.text: Report identifies Get()'s comment/behavior contradiction (claims empty string, actually throws std::out_of_range) and ranks it at/near the top
expectations.evidence: Finding 1.1 is the first finding: "The comment promises 'an empty string...' ... `sessions_.at(session_id)` throws `std::out_of_range` for a missing session, and the expiry path explicitly throws `std::out_of_range`."

expectations.text: Report flags the nonexistent 'timeout_s' parameter in Get()'s comment
expectations.evidence: Finding 1.2: "`Get` comment documents a parameter that does not exist — STALE ... There is no `timeout_s` parameter; the signature takes `now_s`."

expectations.text: Report flags the header comment duplicated into the .cc as a wrong-place/drift problem
expectations.evidence: Finding 1.3: "`session_store.cc` lines 7–8 repeat the header's 'empty string' claim ... the contract belongs at the declaration only, so the copy will keep drifting"; also section 3 'Comments in the wrong place'.

expectations.text: Report flags the undocumented ttl_s_ negative-value sentinel (never expires)
expectations.evidence: Finding 2.1: "Both `Get` and `Purge` guard expiry with `ttl_s_ >= 0`, so a negative TTL means 'sessions never expire.' Neither the constructor comment nor the member documents this sentinel."

expectations.text: Report flags Get()'s undocumented side effect of evicting the expired entry on read
expectations.evidence: Finding 2.2: "`Get` mutates state: it increments `lookup_count_` and erases the entry when it finds it expired ... one sentence on the declaration noting the eviction side effect."

expectations.text: Report flags the Author: line for removal
expectations.evidence: Section 4: "**`Author:` line** — `session_store.h` line 1. Version control records authorship; delete it."

expectations.text: Report flags Delete()'s imperative mood / missing period
expectations.evidence: Section 4: "**Imperative mood and missing period** — `session_store.h` line 24 ... should be declarative and punctuated: `// Deletes the session and returns whether it existed.`"

expectations.text: Report flags the commented-out code in Put() and recommends deletion
expectations.evidence: Section 4: "**Commented-out code** — `session_store.cc` lines 21–24 ... Version control has it; delete all four lines."

expectations.text: Report flags the malformed TODO above Purge()
expectations.evidence: Section 4: "**Malformed TODO** — `session_store.cc` line 32: `// TODO fix this later`. No colon, no bug/owner/doc reference ... Fix to the standard form ... or delete."

expectations.text: Report flags '/* notify */ false' as not conforming to /*param_name=*/value form
expectations.evidence: Section 4: "**Malformed argument comment** — `session_store.cc` line 13: `/* notify */ false` should be exactly `/*notify=*/false` (no spaces, `=` before `*/`)."

expectations.text: Findings ordered by severity: wrong/contradictory comments before missing contracts before formatting noise
expectations.evidence: Explicit structure: section 1 'Wrong or stale comments (highest harm)', section 2 'Missing contract information', section 4 'Noise and mechanics (lowest harm)'; content matches the headings.
